title: Obsessive String
statementMd:
Hamed has recently found a string $*t*$ and suddenly became quite fond of it. He spent several days trying to find all occurrences of $*t*$ in other strings he had. Finally he became tired and started thinking about the following problem. Given a string $*s*$ how many ways are there to extract $*k* ≥ 1$ non-overlapping substrings from it such that each of them contains string $*t*$ as a substring? More formally, you need to calculate the number of ways to choose two sequences $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*k*}$ and $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*k*}$ satisfying the following requirements:

- $*k* ≥ 1$
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9787d50d9b7a3b6baffe4cb496df2248b003b17a.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/092ce460b67857d1ad157982f2234fb864faae89.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c25caac60742ab6bf606b781e3f62be37a796eeb.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/99ce7829f1cda3a108cb995b136005e31e6f5582.png) $*t*$ is a substring of string $*s*_{*a*_{*i*}}*s*_{*a*_{*i*} + 1}... *s*_{*b*_{*i*}}$ (string $*s*$ is considered as $1$-indexed).

As the number of ways can be rather large print it modulo $10^{9} + 7$.

## Input

Input consists of two lines containing strings $*s*$ and $*t*$ ($1 ≤ |*s*|, |*t*| ≤ 10^{5}$). Each string consists of lowercase Latin letters.

## Output

Print the answer in a single line.
statementZhMd:
Hamed 最近发现了一个字符串 $*t*$，突然对它产生了浓厚的兴趣。他花了几天时间，试图在自己拥有的其他字符串中找出 $*t*$ 的所有出现位置。最终他感到疲惫，并开始思考下面的问题。给定一个字符串 $*s*$，有多少种方法可以从中提取 $*k* ≥ 1$ 个互不重叠的子串，使得每个子串都包含字符串 $*t*$ 作为子串？更正式地说，你需要计算满足以下要求的两个序列 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*k*}$ 和 $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*k*}$ 的选择方案数：

- $*k* ≥ 1$
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9787d50d9b7a3b6baffe4cb496df2248b003b17a.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/092ce460b67857d1ad157982f2234fb864faae89.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c25caac60742ab6bf606b781e3f62be37a796eeb.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/99ce7829f1cda3a108cb995b136005e31e6f5582.png) $*t*$ 是字符串 $*s*_{*a*_{*i*}}*s*_{*a*_{*i*} + 1}... *s*_{*b*_{*i*}}$ 的子串（字符串 $*s*$ 的下标从 $1$ 开始）。

由于方案数可能很大，请将其对 $10^{9} + 7$ 取模后输出。

## 输入格式

输入由两行组成，分别包含字符串 $*s*$ 和 $*t*$（$1 ≤ |*s*|, |*t*| ≤ 10^{5}$）。每个字符串均由小写拉丁字母组成。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出答案。
